description: The rules each deterministic checker of an agent's output enforces beyond its schema's shape, each with the one instruction home that states it, and the readers of saved state with the schema of the writer they read. scripts/check-contract-conformance.mjs (run in pre-commit) verifies that each checker's code holds each rule, that the home states it, that every producing agent reaches the home, that every message a checker writes is a registered rule, that every checker in the code is registered, and that each reader reads only what its writer's schema defines. The shapes of the outputs are agent-outputs.json's, checked by scripts/check-agent-output-formats.mjs.
